description: A React component for managing workout sessions, providing UI for listing, adding, editing, and deleting workouts, utilizing context and internal state management.

methods.name: WorkoutsPage()
methods.description: Main React functional component for displaying and managing workout sessions.

methods.name: beginAdd
methods.description: Starts the process of adding a new workout session.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing an existing workout session.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles submission of new workout session, adds it via context.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Handles updating an existing workout session via context.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a workout session after user confirms.
